entries.0096572fc5dc3ef0: Surveying measuring instruments and maintenance services
entries.02060b437e8f9c13: This is a reportable segment whose main markets are the market for automobiles and MaaS (a service that provides mobility as a package) and the market for three-dimensional DX for local governments, civil engineering and construction, and it is the category with the largest net sales to external customers.
entries.058b53ea3215eb7c: Automotive-related and MaaS-related businesses, local governments, and civil engineering and construction parties (counterparties that the securities report lists as main markets)
entries.086f3f1f6d3c04b4: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the Group consists of the company and 4 subsidiaries, and conducts in-house development, sales and support of surveying software, sales of measuring instruments, sales and maintenance of MMS (high-precision three-dimensional mobile mapping system) and contract work for three-dimensional measurement and analysis, consigned sales of autonomous driving-related systems and contract work for demonstration tests, and various surveys of land, rivers and oceans. The business is divided by market into two [[term:segment|reportable segments]], Public and Mobility and DX, and real estate leasing is a category not included in the reportable segments. Revenue is disclosed in four categories: in-house software sales and related services, measuring instrument sales and related services, contract work and related services, and other. Of revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, contract work and related services was the largest category, and the “Related Information” section of the annual securities report states that there is no customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.1bac029cbca60cd7: Contracted three-dimensional measurement and analysis work using MMS, and contracted work to build high-precision three-dimensional map databases
entries.1d69bdf513f9124a: This reportable segment mainly serves the automotive and MaaS (services that provide transportation as a bundle) markets and the markets for three-dimensional DX in local governments, civil engineering and construction, and it has the largest sales to external customers. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 18.6% from the previous fiscal year. It sells MMS (devices mounted on vehicles that measure roads and townscapes in three dimensions) measuring instruments and related products, undertakes three-dimensional measurement and analysis using MMS and the building of high-precision three-dimensional map databases, undertakes the construction of autonomous driving systems and demonstration tests, and provides satellite positioning services and other services. The consolidated subsidiary Surido Co., Ltd. handles three-dimensional measurement, and A-Drive Co., Ltd. (the company holds 60% of its voting rights; a specified subsidiary) handles the social implementation of autonomous driving. The annual securities report states that both sales and segment profit grew substantially because of an increase in the number of orders received and cost reductions.

entries.6da00c6c143f3e89: In the Public segment, it sells software such as surveying CAD and surveying measuring instruments, provides maintenance services, and undertakes various surveys on contract. In the Mobility and DX segment, it undertakes three-dimensional measurement using MMS and construction of high-precision three-dimensional map databases, and provides autonomous driving system construction, demonstration tests and remote monitoring systems that support operations, among others. The MD&A states that autonomous driving vehicles include the small EV bus “Tier IV Minibus”, the large bus “ERGA” developed with Isuzu Motors Ltd., and carts from Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd., among others.
entries.6efcb6250de5dfcd: Services related to satellite positioning, and three-dimensional point cloud processing software
entries.950ea21bf3d3be44: It consists of the company and 4 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] (Suriido Co., Ltd., Sanwa Co., Ltd., A-Drive Co., Ltd. and Akisoku Ltd.). Consolidated number of employees was 197 (as of March 31, 2026; the annual average number of temporary employees was 12). The annual securities report states that research and development expenses totaled ¥131 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, and that the Public segment developed a new platform using high-precision position calculation technology for surveying software, while the Mobility and DX segment analyzed three-dimensional high-precision position information, created map databases and carried out development for building autonomous driving vehicles.

entries.c1b4b50a4a969779: This reportable segment mainly serves the surveying and real estate markets. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 27.1% from the previous fiscal year. It sells software and maintenance services for surveying and civil engineering, processing software for three-dimensional point clouds (large volumes of positional data measured by lasers and other means), and measuring instruments for surveying with their maintenance services, and also undertakes land, river and marine surveys. The consolidated subsidiary Sanwa Co., Ltd. undertakes surveying work, and Akisoku Limited Company serves as a sales outlet for the company's products. The annual securities report states that sales grew substantially because the main surveying CAD system "WingneoINFINITY" did well with update proposals timed to the end of Windows10 support and the revision of the standard work regulations for public surveying, and because large projects from government offices were won.
entries.c8ee974f6559ffc8: Rental income from real estate the company owns. The securities report describes this category as a "business segment not included in the reportable segments" and states that its sales fell 13.4% year on year. Because it is not a reportable segment, it is placed last regardless of the size of its sales.

entries.d7b82f38002d7a73: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,593 million, up 22.1% from ¥6,220 million in the previous year. By reportable segment, revenue from external customers rose 27.1% in Public and 18.6% in Mobility & DX. The annual securities report states that the reasons for the increase were, in the Public segment, strong sales of proposals to update its flagship "WingneoINFINITY" and the winning of large government projects, and, in the Mobility & DX segment, an increase in the number of orders received and cost reductions.
entries.eb018d7eba01d94c: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 69.2% from the previous year, ordinary profit rose 71.0%, and profit attributable to owners of the parent rose 82.4%. The operating margin on revenue rose from 7.2% in the previous year to 10.0%. The MD&A of the annual securities report cites, as factors behind the margin improvement, a higher share of sales of high value-added in-house products, and efficiency gains in cost of sales and selling, general and administrative expenses through the use of generative AI and in-sourcing of operations. The company also states that, based on the investigation report of the Special Investigation Committee on suspected improper transactions and misconduct at its consolidated subsidiary, Yugen-gaisha Akiyoshi, it verified prior-period accounting treatment, examined in detail the amount of the impact on the consolidated financial statements, and reflected this in the annual securities report.
entries.f08c66185dabcfee: Surveying and real estate, automotive and MaaS, and local government, civil engineering and construction markets
entries.f2bafb7e68d24a3c: The annual securities report states that the Public segment targets the surveying and real estate markets, the Mobility & DX segment targets the automotive-related and MaaS-related markets, and the three-dimensional DX for local governments, civil engineering and construction is the main target market. In autonomous driving, it states that the company took part in 17 regions out of the 67 projects selected under the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism's autonomous driving social implementation promotion project, and the MD&A says it will advance dialogue with local governments and transport operators. Because sales to external customers in Japan exceed 90% of revenue in the consolidated statement of income, regional revenue is not disclosed.
